entry.content: Summary banks parses Tool JSON objects from the rendered body of {% completion %} blocks and later resolves their import_path field through importlib.import_module(...) + getattr(...) to obtain the callable that handles a tool call. There is no allowlist or sanitization on import_path, so any importable Python attribute (e.g. os.system, subprocess.getoutput) can be selected. entry.title: [odf-kit] odf-kit: HTML injection leading to XSS in odtToHtml() and odsToHtml() via unescaped style attribute values | Security Advisory for JavaScript packages hosted at npmjs.com
entry.summary: SummaryODF style attribute values are interpolated into style="..." attributes without HTML-escaping in both of odf-kit's to-HTML renderers (odtToHtml and odsToHtml). A double-quote character inside a
entry.content: SummaryODF style attribute values are interpolated into style="..." attributes without HTML-escaping in both of odf-kit's to-HTML renderers (odtToHtml and odsToHtml). A double-quote character inside an attacker-controlled style value breaks out of the attribute, allowing arbitrary HTML/attribute injection — and therefore script execution (XSS) — from a crafted .odt or .ods file wherever the rendered output is inserted as HTML, which is the documented purpose of both functions.DetailsODT renderer

entry.content: TL;DRLoading an attacker-supplied lemma .pt runs arbitrary code as the loading user. entry.title: [@enspirit/elo] Elo JavaScript emitter has sandbox escape to arbitrary Node.js / browser code execution via unfiltered `.constructor` member access | Security Advisory for JavaScript packages hosted at npmjs.com
entry.summary: SummaryAn unauthenticated attacker who controls a string passed to any Elo JavaScript-emission path — defaultFormats.elo.parse(), the bin/elo CLI, or the live browser playground at elo-lang.org/try —
entry.content: SummaryAn unauthenticated attacker who controls a string passed to any Elo JavaScript-emission path — defaultFormats.elo.parse(), the bin/elo CLI, or the live browser playground at elo-lang.org/try — can execute arbitrary code in the host JavaScript runtime. A payload built from the .constructor.constructor chain compiles, without modification, to a live Function invocation in the emitted JavaScript, escaping any sandbox assumption around "Elo is a safe data/DSL language."Vulnerable sink and roo

entry.title: [pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish] pypi-publish action revocation of CA in the chain that Sigstore uses in Trusted Publishing and Digital Attestations for PyPI | Security Advisory for Github Actions
entry.summary: SummaryThe pypi-publish action versions before 1.14.2 used to bundle the emSign root CA trust store certificate through the certifi distribution. It has since been removed through the bundle and the n
entry.content: SummaryThe pypi-publish action versions before 1.14.2 used to bundle the emSign root CA trust store certificate through the certifi distribution. It has since been removed through the bundle and the new version no longer includes them.DetailsThe certifi-provided TLS trust store is typically used by many projects in the Python ecosystem, including Sigstore that pypi-publish relies on for Trusted Publishing and Digital Attestations.RelatedThe external compromise is being tracked at https://emudhra
